apps/dashboard.name: server.shoal
apps/dashboard._comment: Keeps the pre-split URL: the dashboard proxies /api and /ws to api.shoal, so workers and API clients can keep using server.shoal. The fixed port gives clients that can't trust portless's CA (e.g. Jan) a stable http://localhost:3100/v1; it's outside portless's random 4000-4999 range.

apps/cli._comment: Skip CLI from `bun run dev` auto-discovery — its TLS+timing semantics differ from the HTTP apps. Run it separately with `bun run dev:cli`.

apps/desktop._comment: Skip desktop from `bun run dev` auto-discovery — it's a native app, not an HTTP service. Run it separately with `bun run dev:desktop`.
